design: Project-original two-room route with one finite public reinforcement per room. Next wave comes in next room round after existing start ticks; all room clocks/cursors/once use/player and enemy stock/summons persist. No new gear/skill/damage formula/permanent supply economy; only full room completion pays room rewards.
limit: 18 predeclared fresh route/plan/seed inputs and actual earned departures10/11. Same seed is not paired attack randomness once actions differ; no global balance, avoided damage or single-skill win attribution.
